messages:
raj: Heads-up — thinking through rollout handback for auto-degrade. Current problem: loud oscillations when traffic flaps and we keep switching between primary and fallback. Anyone have UX/ops ideas to reduce noise?
marta: +1 saw this in canary last week. We need hysteresis + visibility. Maybe a 'quiet handback' mode that rate-limits switches and requires a sustained healthy window before switching back.
jie: agree. also add an audit trail entry every time route changes with reason + metrics snapshot. we should expose the snapshot link in the console.
leo: this. and UI-wise don't spam notifications — group repeated switches into one 'session' with count and first/last timestamps.
emily: how would admins override? a manual 'force-handback' button? but that could be abused.
raj: proposal: three handback modes — instant, delayed, and gated. gated needs manual approval; delayed uses exponential backoff + min-stable-window. instant is current default.
marta: UX for delayed: show a progress bar with remaining stabilization time and a cancel button. also show predicted cost delta if we switch.
jie: telemetry: label every switch event with tags: rollout_id, trigger_metric, threshold_value, kv_snapshot_url. retention 90d by default.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Alert: rollout/1123 entered fallback at 16:42 UTC (error-rate spike). :warning:
raj: example policy snippet (for console quick-edit):
```json
{
  "handback_mode": "delayed",
  "min_stable_seconds": 120,
  "backoff_policy": "exp(2s)",
  "oscillation_guard": {
    "max_switches_per_hour": 3,
    "session_coalesce_window": 900
  }
}
```
leo: Nice. For oscillation guard we should surface the 'switch budget' in route detail and in alerts.
emily: UX question: in the rollout timeline, do we show every attempted handback (even those blocked by guard)? I'd show attempted but greyed with reason 'blocked-by-oscillation-guard'.
marta: agree. Also add an 'explain why' popover that surfaces last 3 metric snapshots and a simple summary sentence.
jie: one more: add an API endpoint to replay a switch event with recorded snapshot for forensic testing.
raj: ok I'll draft a tiny console prototype and an API PR. Will post screenshots tomorrow. :thumbsup:
